Product overview

SJ250 combines an MT250 two-stroke engine with a 105 kg kerb weight, long-travel suspension and full-size 21/18-inch wheels for fast response across trails, training grounds and demanding off-road terrain.

MT250 two-stroke engine25 kW output and 30 N·m torque for immediate throttle response.
105 kg kerb weightLight mass supports quick direction changes and easier recovery.
Long-travel suspension838 mm front and 509 mm rear shock units absorb rough terrain.
Full disc brakesFront and rear disc brakes provide consistent off-road control.
